hard_constraints: Single POV: Ben Skywalker throughout; no head-hopping or external narration.
Preserve Legends continuity: Luke Skywalker as Grand Master of the Jedi Order on Coruscant Temple post-Fate of the Jedi (47 ABY).

Force description: Experiential and sensory only (e.g., 'sourness under the Temple's usual harmonics'); no diagnostic terms like 'Weave' or 'unweaving' (first appearance Ch 9). Use 'wrongness' per Ben's personal term (registry).
Terminology: Datapad (not laptop/computer); comlink/comm (not radio); no anachronisms (e.g., DNA->genetic material). Decapitalize 'galaxy'; capitalize 'Human' if used.
No meta-references: No ABY/BBY, 'Legends'/'Canon', film/book titles, or Wookieepedia-style taxonomy.
Style: American English; 'Jedi' singular/plural (no 'Jedis'); no forbidden repeat phrases (e.g., 'reached for the Force').
canon_risks: Jedi survey mission protocols: Scene implies routine Outer Rim surveys with Force anomaly flags; risk of over-inventing hierarchy/details not in provided materials (e.g., assignment process). Stick to functional briefing.
Luke/Ben relationship: Post-Fate of the Jedi (Abeloth crisis resolved); ensure warmth with institutional distance, no unresolved Lost Tribe/Vestara bleed beyond Ben's preserved canon history.
Force perception: Skywalker bloodline sensitivity heightened but differentiated (Ben visceral, Luke clinical); avoid equating to Disney midi-chlorian or Sequel-era framing.
legends_continuity_notes: 47 ABY: Galactic Alliance primary government; Jedi Temple on Coruscant operational under Luke as Grand Master; post-Abeloth, Force settling but no major disruptions.
Ben Skywalker: ~20-21, Jedi Knight; GAG service under Jacen, Mara murdered by Jacen/Caedus, Vestara Khai dark side choice preserved.
Jedi Temple: Administrative spaces functional/lived-in; Grand Master's office includes holocomm/desk for briefings.
Father-son dynamic: Communicates via mission briefings; Ben internal 'Dad', external Knight-to-Grand Master formality.
required_context_for_drafter: Setting: Luke's office, Jedi Temple Coruscant – functional, lived-in, holocomm/desk; Coruscant traffic low wash; Luke's presence warm/familiar; wrongness faint sourness.
Emotional arc: Guarded attentiveness -> brief connection -> deliberate distance; Ben accepts solo mission silently.
Key beats: Datapad with 17 flagged reports (Outer Rim bearing); Ben zooms 3 matching his perception; moves to window accepting solo.
Relationship turn: Institutional distance to private alliance (Luke validates wrongness; no partner offered/asked).
Wrongness: Ben's subjective 'the Wrongness' (Ch1 term); sensory (sourness, off-note); directional toward seal.
Subplots: SP-A (Ben's practical dependence), SP3 (Luke's shadow); hook H01 plant.
No flashbacks/recaps: Mara/Jacen as grounding phrases only if surfaced (e.g., 'his mother').
allowed_au_divergences: The 'wrongness': AU seal deterioration from Ruusan Atonement; manifests as persistent low-grade Force distortion directional to Veranthos.
Survey route: Aligns with Ruusan Corridor/Veranthos bearing per premise.
open_questions: Precise Jedi survey protocols/assignment hierarchy: Provided materials imply Knight-level solo with pilot; confirm Legends sources if needed beyond functional briefing.
Jedi Temple office details: Functional per scene; any specific post-FotJ Legends descriptions?
